name: Folder
notes: Logical container for assets and projects. Good early candidate for hierarchy and path modeling.

name: Connection
notes: Important for graph modeling because many tasks and mappings depend on connections.

name: Mapping
notes: Core design artifact for data movement and transformation logic.

name: Mapping Task
notes: Likely high-value v1 type because it connects mappings, schedules, and runtime behavior.

name: Task
notes: Generic task inventory entry when task subtypes are surfaced through a broader endpoint.

name: Taskflow
notes: Useful for orchestration graph views and task dependency expansion.

name: Schedule
notes: Useful for operational metadata and graph relationships from jobs to schedules.

name: Runtime Environment
notes: Represents Secure Agent groups or runtime execution contexts when exposed by the API.

name: Secure Agent
notes: Useful for environment inventory and runtime troubleshooting views.

name: Source Object
notes: Placeholder logical type for extracted source-side objects discovered through task or mapping details rather than first-class list APIs.

name: Target Object
notes: Placeholder logical type for extracted target-side objects discovered through task or mapping details rather than first-class list APIs.
